# UC41 — Third-party search server, filtered at the gateway

**Track:** controls  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T6 · Sections: §4.2.2

## Buyer Story

An agent that can search the open web is useful and dangerous in the same breath. The business needs the useful half without hand-auditing every query, and without asking the search vendor to enforce a policy it has never heard of.

## PingOne Solution

The Agent Gateway fronts a third-party Brave Search MCP server and inspects the query argument against a content policy before the request leaves the perimeter — the search vendor never sees a blocked query at all.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Chip message: `search the news for PingOne DaVinci`  
**Expected outcome:** `PERMIT`

## What to Say

> An ordinary business search — no blocked term, so the gateway forwards it to the real Brave API.

## Evidence

**Token chain steps:** user-token → tool-dispatched  
**Activity categories:** token, mcp
